cloudOff.name: add
cloudOff.description: Adds a computer of the person's over ssh and sets it up from a saved recipe, as `wsp add <user@host> --recipe <name>` does: address is user@host or an alias from the ssh config, and the host logs in, checks it can run wsp there (root, systemd with cgroup v2, room on the disk), installs wsp, waits for it to dial back, then puts on the base tools and everything the recipe picks. With resume, address names a computer already added, or one that joined and waits on its picks, and sets it up again: from recipe where one is named, else from what it holds, running only what is missing, a sign-in that waited or ran out among it. This tool never waits on the person: it answers at the first sign-in waiting on them (the page and the code are in waiting, to hand over), at the end, or after ten minutes, and is called again with resume for the next of those; with later it does not stop at a sign-in and leaves it waiting. setup is the setup's steps as the computer's row holds them, each with its state and what it took; an install that fails is refused with the step it failed at. A computer this host has never dialled needs host_key, as the person read it off that computer, or the add is refused with the key it answered with. A project, a provider's key and the join code are not added here: projects_add records a project, and the other two belong at the host's own terminal.

address.description: user@host, an alias from the ssh config, or with resume a computer already added

recipe.description: the saved recipe to set it up from, as recipes lists it

later.description: go on past a sign-in that waits on the person and leave it waiting

resume.description: set up a computer already added, or one that joined and waits on its picks

name.description: what to call the computer here; what its address calls it without one

ssh_port.description: the port ssh dials it on (default 22)

ssh_key.description: the key file ssh logs in with

host_key.description: the host key of a computer this one has never dialled, as read off that computer
